items.name: abrt-journal-core.service (ABRT)

applies.note: Fedora 44 and earlier (no abrt package in Workstation comps groups in 45)

items.notes: F44 Workstation comps ship abrt-cli (default in workstation-product) but not gnome-abrt; F45 comps have no abrt package in the Workstation groups. Engine must skip when the unit is not found. Retrace server does not support F43/F44.

items.name: GNOME: send technical problem reports
items.notes: Upstream default is already false; distro overrides not verified.

items.name: GNOME: send software usage stats
items.notes: Upstream default is already false.

items.name: kerneloops (kernel oops reporter)
items.notes: Recommends of ubuntu-desktop-minimal (binary package is kerneloops; the seed calls it kerneloops-daemon). Submits oops signatures to oops.kernel.org.

items.name: Debian popularity-contest participation
items.notes: Default is already "no" unless the user opted in. Engine must skip if the file is absent.

items.name: popularity-contest package
items.notes: Priority optional; Depends only on debconf and dpkg. Not a dependency of gnome, gnome-core or task-gnome-desktop.

items.name: Ubuntu Insights (telemetry)
items.notes: Recommends of ubuntu-desktop-minimal. Opt-in, per-user consent; no system-wide opt-out, Canonical suggests removing the package. With consent false an {"OptOut": true} payload is still sent. CLI alternative: ubuntu-insights consent -s=false.

items.name: Ubuntu Report (install-time telemetry)
items.notes: Recommends of ubuntu-desktop-minimal. Ships user units ubuntu-report.path / ubuntu-report.service and an autostart file.

items.name: Whoopsie (error report uploader)
items.notes: Recommends of ubuntu-desktop-minimal.

items.name: whoopsie.path
items.notes: apport-autoreport treats a disabled whoopsie.path as "do nothing" (fixed in apport 2.28.1-0ubuntu3.1; earlier noble builds logged a failure).

items.name: whoopsie.service
items.notes: Uploads crash reports to the Ubuntu error tracker.

items.name: Apport crash notification popups
items.notes: Hides crash dialogs only; does not stop collection.

items.name: GNOME: location services
items.notes: Upstream default false. Sunrise/sunset Night Light depends on location (gnome-settings-daemon issue 71).

items.name: GNOME: remember application usage
items.notes: Upstream default true. Local only.

items.name: GNOME: remember recent files
items.notes: Upstream default true. Recent-files lists go empty. Local only, no network.

items.name: Ubuntu MOTD news fetch

applies.note: Ubuntu 22.04+ (file ships in motd-news-config, pulled in by ubuntu-server; desktops disabled by default)

items.notes: Canonical-documented switch. The fetch sends OS version, kernel, arch, CPU model, uptime and cloud id. Engine must skip if the file is absent.

items.name: motd-news.timer
items.notes: Users report the timer still triggers motd-news.service with ENABLED=0 (LP #2022825); the maintainer said users are free to disable the timer.

items.name: Avahi mDNS/DNS-SD daemon
items.notes: avahi-daemon.socket must be disabled too. Breaks mDNS name resolution (nss-mdns) and DNS-SD service discovery for D-Bus clients.

items.name: Avahi activation socket
items.notes: Pair with avahi-daemon-service.

items.name: cups-browsed (network printer auto-discovery)
items.notes: Default member of the printing group. Network printers are no longer auto-detected; already configured printers keep working. Subject of CVE-2024-47176.

items.name: fwupd metadata refresh timer
items.notes: Stops the periodic firmware metadata refresh and its MOTD notice. fwupd.service itself is a separate unit.

items.name: ModemManager
items.notes: Breaks mobile broadband modems (ModemManager is the API for them).

items.name: Bluetooth daemon (bluez)
items.notes: Disables Bluetooth support (bluez is the seed base for bluetooth support).

items.name: CUPS printing system
items.notes: Recommends of ubuntu-desktop-minimal. Removes printing. DO NOT apply on Debian 13 (hard Depends of gnome-core) or Fedora (mandatory in printing group).

items.name: LocalSearch file indexer (localsearch 3.8+)

applies.note: Fedora 44, 45 (localsearch in gnome-desktop group); any distro shipping localsearch >= 3.8

items.notes: Also started by D-Bus activation and XDG autostart, so disable alone may not keep it stopped (mask is outside the engine op set). Desktop file search/indexing stops.

items.name: Tracker Miner FS file indexer (tracker-miners 3.x)

applies.note: Ubuntu 24.04 (unit verified in tracker-miner-fs on noble)

items.notes: Same caveat as localsearch-indexer: D-Bus/XDG-autostart activation can restart it.

items.name: Security Center (snap)
items.notes: Seeded together with prompting-client.

items.name: Firmware Updater (snap)
items.notes: GUI front end for firmware updates; the fwupd deb remains.

items.name: Snap permission prompting client
items.notes: Seeded together with desktop-security-center.

items.name: Firefox (snap)
items.notes: Default browser. Seed comment: desktop snaps also exist in DistUpgradeQuirks.py for users who upgrade. Purging snapd with firefox snap <129 present failed in postrm (LP #2058810).

items.name: App Center / Ubuntu Software (snap-store)
items.notes: Graphical software centre. Leaves no GUI installer unless another is installed.

items.name: snapd (snap daemon)

applies.note: Ubuntu 22.04-26.10; Mint 20 documents blocking it via /etc/apt/preferences.d/nosnap.pref

items.notes: Removes every snap (Firefox, Thunderbird 24.04+, App Center, firmware-updater, Security Center, gnome/mesa runtimes). Transitional thunderbird deb reinstalls it. Release upgrader checks Snap Store connectivity and replaces debs with snaps when snapd is installed. Recommends of ubuntu-desktop-minimal.
